key_insight: LLM-guided redesign can match numerical solvers’ feasible-design discovery with 80% fewer simulator evaluations while tripling the fraction of runs finding near-optimal solutions.
engineering_relevance: Combining engineering context from LLMs with black-box optimization can reduce costly simulation calls when adapting existing designs to new requirements.
method: Integrate LLMs through warm starts, variable fixing, or ReAct.
Compare Bayesian optimization, genetic algorithms, mesh adaptive direct search, and random search.
Test electric vehicle battery pack cost minimization across four redesign scenario types.
evidence_signal: The battery pack case study compares three LLM integration methods and four black-box solvers, finding that the best integration strategy depends on the structure of the requirement change.
watch_item: Results come from one engineering case study; broader applicability and the trade-off between LLM overhead and simulation savings need validation.
